subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: What permanent operator-facing contract should replace the existing ACP streamLogPath response when relay history moves into the per-agent database?
rationale: Keeping streamLogPath implies a compatibility export file, while removing it without a query surface breaks an existing response contract; choosing the durable retrieval and API boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Add a versioned retrieval handle
options.body: Return a stable diagnostic identifier and provide a supported API or CLI reader, retaining compatibility until the old field can be removed in a versioned change.

options.title: Keep a deprecated export path
options.body: Continue producing a bounded named diagnostic export and deprecate streamLogPath with a documented removal window.

options.title: Defer ACP migration
options.body: Leave ACP parent-stream diagnostics on the current path and land the other SQLite journal migrations separately.

recommendation.title: Add a versioned retrieval handle
recommendation.body: Return a stable diagnostic identifier and provide a supported API or CLI reader, retaining compatibility until the old field can be removed in a versioned change.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history connects this owner most directly to the ACP parent-stream relay and its current response behavior.
